scope: unmounted local bibliographic intake with generated fixtures

local_checks.notes: Local tests use Node's experimental built-in SQLite API; exact-head GitHub CI uses the repository's Node 24.

acceptance.GDN-078-AC01: Generated RIS/BibTeX/CSL/manual inputs stay discovery-only, preserve raw metadata, and never become reviewed source claims.
acceptance.GDN-078-AC02: License, access, source locator and provider are explicit. Access denied, robots denied, timeout and rate limits return no new source record.
acceptance.GDN-078-AC03: All dedup results are nonautomatic hints; decisions are append-only with explicit supersession and reviewer reason.

limitations: No real provider API credentials, subscriptions or live lookup executed.
No real archival originals imported to bibliographic store.
Private durable SQLite is a local service adapter, not multiuser hosted acceptance.
Full source licensing, original historical inspection and data authorization remain separate.
